node.title: Complete-support first-moment route cut at clean envelopes
node.statement: At each of the six named high-budget clean predecessor anchors, any support family with |S|>=a has E[N(A)]<B*. Indeed the complete-family FM1 sum is dominated by a geometric tail below B*, with exact RowC binomial certificates and exact rational-entropy prize certificates. Since the averaged supplier has nu(A)=E[N(A)]-(q/2)C_t(A)<=E[N(A)], no deterministic support family can satisfy nu(A)>B* there. This rules out the present M supplier at those envelopes, not direct Q/V payloads or safety.
node.notes: ROUTE CUT 2026-07-27: the first moment is already below budget, so no strict-overlap optimization can rescue averaged_slope_conversion on the six named envelopes.
